cases.name: reliable-units
cases.answer:

cases.name: reliable-uncertainty
cases.answer:
Median and min–max are descriptive ranges across ten preselected hash seeds on each fixed stream, not confidence intervals. Keys share counters, repeated queries share traffic, and the three fixed generated streams do not sample operational networks. No inferential95%interval or rare-event confidence bound is estimated from this design. **Overall probability and complexity theorems: inconclusive** (§4, Table1–2, AppendixA.1–A.5). The stated theorem includes stronger constants, uniform independent hashes and auxiliary SpaceSaving. CPU experiments use heuristic parameters and no fallback. Concentration-conditioning proof steps are not fully independently verified; finite runs cannot test Delta<1e-10.

**Product of per-key confidence: discrepant** (p2 §1; Table1). Shared success event with marginal0.95 has joint0.95, while product is0.9025. Counterexample to unconditional equality; not a disproof of ReliableSketch theorem.

Low-budget dropped updates can invalidate empirical intervals without disproving the theorem under its auxiliary-fallback, larger-constant and independent-hash assumptions. No empirical estimate of Delta<1e-10 or years of operation is supported.
